# SneppX-ALG

> SneppX-ALG is an experimental, open-source machine-learning framework with a native C/C++ core and Python bindings. It focuses on tensor operations, reverse-mode automatic differentiation, and neural-network components.

## Project status

- Maturity: Alpha.
- The latest PyPI package is 1.5.2.
- The current main branch identifies itself as 1.5.3-rc.1; this release candidate is not published to PyPI.
- SneppX-ALG is not a drop-in replacement for PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
- Multi-rank Python distributed training is not currently supported. The process-group and collective APIs fail closed when WORLD_SIZE is greater than 1.
- DDP, FSDP, ZeRO, and NCCL-related surfaces must be treated as experimental unless a specific end-to-end test demonstrates otherwise.
- Security components are experimental, partial, or incomplete. No complete-system independent audit, FIPS validation, or certification is claimed.
- Some model-zoo entries provide architecture configuration presets only; end-to-end pretrained-weight loading is in progress.
